title: Private luxury South Coast tour 10h
excerpt: Discover Iceland’s Dramatic Beauty on a Private Luxury South Coast Tour (10 Hours)
description:
Embark on an extraordinary journey along Iceland’s stunning South Coast with our exclusive Private Luxury Tour. Over the course of 10 hours, you’ll explore some of the most breathtaking landscapes the country has to offer, from majestic waterfalls to black sand beaches, all in the comfort and style that only a private luxury tour can provide.

Your Personalized Adventure Begins
Your day starts with a private pickup from your hotel or preferred location in a luxurious vehicle. With your personal driver and guide, you’ll enjoy a fully customized itinerary tailored to your interests, ensuring an intimate and unforgettable experience. As you travel, your guide will share fascinating insights into Iceland’s history, culture, and natural wonders.

Seljalandsfoss Waterfall
Your first stop is the iconic Seljalandsfoss waterfall. This stunning waterfall cascades from a height of 60 meters, and one of its unique features is the ability to walk behind the waterfall itself. Feel the mist on your face as you take in the power and beauty of this natural wonder, and capture incredible photos from different perspectives.

Skógafoss Waterfall
Next, visit the mighty Skógafoss, one of Iceland’s largest and most famous waterfalls. The thundering curtain of water creates a mist that often produces vivid rainbows on sunny days, making it a perfect spot for photography. If you’re up for a bit of adventure, climb the stairs to the top of the falls for a panoramic view of the surrounding landscape.

Sólheimajökull Glacier
Continue your journey to the Sólheimajökull glacier, where you’ll have the opportunity to witness the awe-inspiring beauty of this icy giant. Your guide will lead you to a safe viewing area where you can marvel at the glacier’s crevasses and ice formations. For those interested in a closer look, an optional glacier walk can be arranged (advance notice required).

Reynisfjara Black Sand Beach
After exploring the glacier, head to Reynisfjara, the world-famous black sand beach. Surrounded by towering basalt columns and the roaring Atlantic Ocean, this beach is both beautiful and dramatic. Your guide will share the geological history that created this unique landscape, as well as the folklore surrounding the Reynisdrangar sea stacks that rise from the ocean just offshore.

Vík í Mýrdal Village
Take a break in the charming village of Vík í Mýrdal, the southernmost village in Iceland. Your guide will recommend the best local restaurants where you can enjoy a gourmet lunch made with fresh Icelandic ingredients and regional specialties. Lunch is at your own expense, giving you the flexibility to choose what suits your taste on the day.

Dyrhólaey Peninsula
Dyrhólaey Peninsula, a natural arch and bird sanctuary offering panoramic views of the South Coast. From the top, you can see the black sand beaches stretching out for miles, the Reynisdrangar sea stacks, and even glaciers in the distance on a clear day. This is also a prime spot for puffin watching during the summer months.

Scenic Drive Back to Reykjavik
As your tour draws to a close, relax during the scenic drive back to Reykjavik. Reflect on the day’s experiences, from the thundering waterfalls and icy glaciers to the dramatic coastline, as you unwind in the comfort of your luxury vehicle.
